concept.title: The Reed-Light Path
concept.hook: Something glints between the reeds where no path is marked.

value.title: The Reed-Light Path
value.description: A lantern glow leads the company off the old road and into the marsh reeds.
value.introduction: The company follows a flicker of light between the reeds. The ground is soft, and the air smells of iron and rain.
value.completionText: The company returns with a new route marked on the guild map.
value.failureText: The reeds close over the trail. The company withdraws without a new route.

concept.title: The Drowned Stair
concept.hook: Stone steps descend into water that never reflects the sky.

value.title: The Drowned Stair
value.description: A drowned stair leads beneath the marsh to a vault the guild once sealed.
value.introduction: The company descends until torchlight cannot reach the ceiling. Water laps at every step.

encounters.title: The flooded landing
encounters.description: Goblin brutes hold the flooded landing.

encounters.title: The sealed vault
encounters.description: A scarred bandit captain waits beside a circle of salt.

value.completionText: The vault is quiet again and the guild has its answer.
value.failureText: The company retreats up the drowned stair with wounded in tow.
